Overview.Name: Nuvvula Laxmi
Overview.Food_Habit: I can eat one bite and stop
Overview.Goal: Looking better (appearance), Feeling energetic & confident, Preventing/reversing health issues, Mental wellbeing & stress reduction
Overview.Preference_Notes: Balanced – include non-veg but not in every meal

Meal_1: Option 1: Cooked rice (1 cup cooked ~150 g) & vegetable curry & curd (200 g)
Option 2: Cooked rice (1 cup cooked ~150 g) & chicken curry (100–120 g) & vegetable curry
Option 3: Cooked rice (1 cup cooked ~150 g) & egg curry (2 eggs) & vegetable curry
Meal_2: Option 1: Cooked rice (1 cup cooked ~150 g) & curd (200 g) & cucumber salad + any 1 fruit
Option 2: Cooked rice (1 cup cooked ~150 g) & vegetable curry & paneer cubes (60 g) + any 1 fruit
Option 3: Cooked rice (1 cup cooked ~150 g) & egg omelette (2 eggs) + any 1 fruit

Notes_and_Tips: Keep meals light and avoid oily or deep fried foods to support liver recovery.
Prefer curd, vegetables and simple home-cooked meals daily.
Limit chicken to few times a week, avoid heavy meat curries.
Walking daily will significantly improve fatty liver condition.
During social gatherings, eat home food first to avoid overeating outside food.
